Technology Trader For Ericsson and Nokia, 5G Can’t Deploy Fast Enough The two wireless merchants are still recovering from the last rollout. Now they face a rival in China’s Huawei, and a still-messy technology. By Tiernan Ray March 3, 2018 
Forget steel and aluminum: The big battle between the U.S. and China is not tariffs, but the future of wireless technology.
